mapper.select: /* 이메일 HMAC으로 회원 조회 */ SELECT MBR_SN , ATCH_FILE_SN , MBR_STTS_CD , MBR_AUTHRT_CD , JOIN_PATH_CD , ACNT_EML_ENC , MBL_TELNO_ENC , PSWD_HASH , MBR_NCNM , LAST_LGN_DT , WHDWL_DT , NCNM_STNG_CMPTN_YN FROM MBR WHERE ACNT_EML_HMAC = #{acntEmlHmac}

SELECT MBR_SN , ATCH_FILE_SN , MBR_STTS_CD , MBR_AUTHRT_CD , JOIN_PATH_CD , ACNT_EML_ENC , MBL_TELNO_ENC , PSWD_HASH , MBR_NCNM , LAST_LGN_DT , SUSPN_END_DT , NCNM_STNG_CMPTN_YN , REG_DT FROM MBR WHERE MBR_SN = #{mbrSn}
SELECT MBR_SN FROM MBR WHERE MBL_TELNO_HMAC = #{mblTelnoHmac} LIMIT 1
SELECT MBR_SN FROM MBR WHERE MBR_NCNM = #{mbrNcnm} LIMIT 1
SELECT SNS_OFFR_CD FROM SNS_ACNT_LINK WHERE MBR_SN = #{mbrSn} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SNS_ACNT_LINK_SN
